_comment: People aged 18 and over in each state and the District of Columbia: the Census Bureau's Current Population Survey of November 2020 (Voting and Registration Supplement, table 4a, total population), as carried in the population file of the authors' replication data (Enns et al., doi:10.7910/DVN/PBGFOF, 'Combined Estimates.dta', Total_Population). Used to centre the state approval figures on the national average of polls of all adults: a national poll of adults is the average of the states weighted by these numbers (pipeline/approval.py, state_approval).
